requirements: decode_optional_float and decode_optional_int MUST return None for the empty string and MUST raise ValueError naming the offending field for any other unparseable input; silently returning None for malformed input is forbidden.
decode_optional_int MUST reject values carrying a fractional part; a decimal in an integer field indicates a schema drift, not a value.

Field mapping MUST be declared per endpoint via DatasetSchema. A single global ISU_CD to ticker rename is forbidden because ISU_CD is the 6-char short code on quote endpoints but the ISIN on sto/*_isu_base_info where the short code is ISU_SRT_CD.

ETF_DAILY_SCHEMA MUST produce exactly the columns date, ticker, name, close, open, high, low, volume, trading_value, nav, market_cap, net_assets, shares_outstanding, underlying_index_name, underlying_index_close.
Ticker validation MUST accept alphanumeric 6-character codes matching ^[0-9A-Z]{6}$ because live codes such as 0131A0 and 0142D0 contain letters.

classify_session MUST determine trading-day status from the ratio of non-empty price values, never from the row count, so that a holiday payload of 1163 rows with every TDD_CLSPRC empty is classified as non-trading.
PanelValidator MUST raise a CRITICAL issue when its own session classification disagrees with TradingCalendar for any date in range; it MUST NOT silently prefer either source.

PanelValidator MUST raise a CRITICAL issue for duplicate rows on the schema key, and for an accounting-identity violation rate above 0.1 percent where relative error of market_cap against shares_outstanding * close exceeds 1e-6.

PanelValidator MUST raise a WARN issue when the relative error of net_assets against shares_outstanding * nav exceeds 1e-4 for more than 1 percent of rows, and when calendar sessions in range are missing from the panel.

Outlier detection MUST use median and MAD only. Mean-based or standard-deviation-based thresholds are forbidden because a single instrument (short code 265690, close 8535 against NAV 48.38) shifts the mean disparity from 34bp to 1524bp.

mark_tradability MUST set is_tradable False, never drop rows, when close is null, trading_value equals 0, absolute disparity exceeds max_abs_disparity, or OHLC consistency fails; dropping rows would silently shorten downstream lookback windows.
SilverBuilder.build MUST NOT write the Parquet output when ValidationReport.is_fatal() is True; it MUST raise instead so that a contaminated panel never reaches disk.
SilverBuilder.build MUST exclude non-trading dates from the written panel entirely.

SilverBuilder.build with mode 'incremental' MUST parse only bronze sessions later than the existing panel maximum date, and a full rebuild MUST produce a frame equal to the incremental result (idempotence).
Parquet output MUST be written with zstd compression through the pyarrow backend to the path given by DataPaths.silver(dataset).
All frame operations MUST use Polars expressions rather than Python row loops on the hot path; per-row Python iteration is only permitted inside decode_rows.
Validation summaries MUST be logged with the [DATA] tag as key=value pairs and MUST truncate any instrument list after 5 entries with a truncated=<count> suffix.

scenarios.expected_behavior: decode_optional_float('', 'NAV') is None; decode_optional_float('34970', 'TDD_CLSPRC') == 34970.0; decode_optional_float('1,234.5', 'MKTCAP') == 1234.5; decode_optional_float('-', 'NAV') raises ValueError whose message contains 'NAV'; decode_optional_int('', 'LIST_SHRS') is None; decode_optional_int('34970.0', 'LIST_SHRS') raises ValueError; decode_bas_dd('20260827') == date(2026,8,27).

ETF_DAILY_SCHEMA.decode_rows on the verified live row {'BAS_DD':'20260827','ISU_CD':'451060','ISU_NM':'1Q 200액티브','TDD_CLSPRC':'34970','NAV':'35057.03','TDD_OPNPRC':'35535','TDD_HGPRC':'35535','TDD_LWPRC':'34660','ACC_TRDVOL':'173366','ACC_TRDVAL':'6064924927','MKTCAP':'440622000000','INVSTASST_NETASST_TOTAMT':'441718559589','LIST_SHRS':'12600000','IDX_IND_NM':'코스피 200','OBJ_STKPRC_IDX':'1088.61','CMPPREVDD_PRC':'460','FLUC_RT':'1.33','CMPPREVDD_IDX':'17.45','FLUC_RT_IDX':'1.63'} yields ticker '451060', close 34970.0, shares_outstanding 12600000, underlying_index_name '코스피 200', and market_cap == shares_outstanding * close exactly. A ticker '0131A0' decodes without error.

classify_session on 1163 rows whose TDD_CLSPRC are all '' returns False even though the row count is large; on 1163 rows all populated it returns True; on a 50/50 mix with min_valid_ratio 0.5 it returns True and with 0.51 it returns False.

PanelValidator.validate flags CRITICAL when the panel contains a date that TradingCalendar reports as a non-session, when a (date, ticker) pair is duplicated, and when more than 0.1 percent of rows break market_cap == shares_outstanding * close within 1e-6. A clean two-session panel produces is_fatal() False.

For a frame of 100 rows whose disparity is drawn near 30bp plus one row replicating short code 265690 with close 8535.0 and nav 48.38 and trading_value 0, mark_tradability sets is_tradable False for exactly that row and True for all others, and the row count is unchanged at 101. Replacing the detector with a mean-based rule would flag zero rows, so the test MUST assert the outlier row is flagged.

mark_tradability sets is_tradable False for a row with close null, for a row with trading_value 0, and for a row where high < low or close falls outside [low, high]; all such rows remain present in the output frame.

Given a bronze store holding 2026-08-14 (populated), 2026-08-15 (all prices empty) and 2026-08-18 (populated), SilverBuilder.build('etf_daily', mode='full') writes a Parquet whose distinct dates are exactly {2026-08-14, 2026-08-18}, whose schema matches ETF_DAILY_SCHEMA plus is_tradable, and whose file lives at DataPaths.silver('etf_daily').

Building full, then adding one later bronze session and building incremental, produces a frame equal (same rows, same order after sorting by date and ticker) to a fresh full rebuild over all sessions. When the validator returns a fatal report, build raises and DataPaths.silver('etf_daily') does not exist afterwards.

'normalize' is a key of SUBCOMMANDS and main(['normalize', '--dataset', 'etf_daily', '--mode', 'full']) returns 0 against a temporary bronze store and non-zero when the validator reports a fatal issue.
